ex membranis castigandus, supplendus, transformandus: Nec suis
carebat mendis Antonini, vel cuiuscumque censendum, Iti-

natus, & Hieronymus Surita, Casar-Augustanus, quo in hoc
argumento Hispania numquam habuit feliciorem. Hinc factum,

revocari castra: quod non infeliciter à me factum in Gallia Ita-
liaque, res ipsa docebit. Procurrit hac Tabula ab Occidentali

page.notes: Printed text is set in italic throughout; the first word "Vnam" is followed by a long-s style ligature rendered as s. Several words are doubtful, notably "s talia" (likely Italia with a swash I), "Cis-Padana", "duētu" and "Velseri", which are read as printed. The bottom line is cut off at the right edge ("distan-").
